requirements.title: Explicit trust boundaries
requirements.statement: Every component MUST identify inputs crossing trust boundaries and validate them before use.

requirements.title: Least privilege
requirements.statement: Components MUST grant only the permissions required for the requested operation.

requirements.title: Fail closed
requirements.statement: Authorization and policy evaluation failures MUST deny protected operations.

requirements.title: Provenance
requirements.statement: Externally sourced evidence MUST retain source and acquisition context where lawful.

requirements.title: No exactly-once claims
requirements.statement: Distributed execution MUST use idempotency and explicit retry semantics rather than claiming exactly-once execution.

requirements.title: Compatibility
requirements.statement: Published interfaces MUST be versioned and have documented compatibility rules.
